verdict.rationale: Lever's Advanced Nurture feature supports automated, personalized outreach and reconnecting/following up with past candidates at scale, which aligns with CRM-style nurture campaigns for future roles. However, evidence lacks detail on prospect pool management, email sequence tracking (opens/replies), and dedicated sourcing/CRM tooling for prospects who haven't yet applied. missing for 10: prospect pool/CRM structure details, email sequence tracking metrics, sourcing-specific workflows distinct from candidate nurture.
